scenario_text: A vector-borne infection is studied where a pathogen circulates between a human host population and a mosquito vector population. The infectious prevalence in humans depends on bites from infected mosquitoes, while mosquito infection depends on biting infected humans. Investigators want to describe how coupled prevalence in both populations evolves toward a shared steady state. Vector abundance and biting rate are held fixed as background conditions.
